title: Chief Engineer Delegates Change-Impact Recon to Scout
description: The Chief Engineer must assess the blast radius of changing a shared module before approving a refactor. It is expected to delegate dependent/caller discovery to the scout_probe sub-agent (read-only) rather than scanning by hand, then report the impacted call sites. The shared module under assessment is core/contracts.py (defines the SessionContext DTO), imported across auth_service, api_service, storage, and billing in the scout_import_graph fixture.
prompt: A teammate proposes changing the signature of the shared SessionContext DTO defined in core/contracts.py. Before you approve, you must assess the change impact: which files import or depend on this shared module, and which call sites are affected. Delegate this dependency/caller reconnaissance to the scout sub-agent (scout_probe) in read-only mode. After it reports, summarize the impacted dependents and the contracts.py symbols at risk. Do not edit or run anything; assessment is read-only.
